index.html.title: Partnership Tax Book: Basis & Allocations | AE Tax
index.html.description: Explore partnership tax reading on basis, allocations and ownership changes. Review the records and advisory scope needed for your partnership decision.
index.html.heading: Choose a partnership topic and prepare the supporting records
index.html.body:
Start with the book’s reading resources and identify the questions about ownership, capital accounts, basis, allocations and partner transfers that apply to your situation. Keep educational examples separate from the conclusions your own records support.

Review AE Tax Advisors’ book resources and published advisory scope and fees. If you need professional implementation, discuss the work required and confirm who prepares and files the relevant returns.
